Interface ObjectParser.Factory

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface ObjectParser.Factory
Extension point for a named XML object tag. Construct and validate the object; ObjectParser applies common properties and attaches group children afterward.
